text: Deirdre picked up an urgent DAFM payments query for me while I was out of office and had it fully resolved with the client before I was back online. Completely reliable under pressure.

Roland spent an evening walking me through the Justice case management workflow before a big release, no fuss, just wanted the team to land it smoothly. Exactly the kind of support that keeps this team working well together.
Priya reworked our AWS Jaguar deployment pipeline so a release that used to take half a day now takes twenty minutes. Quietly one of the most useful things anyone's shipped for this team all year.
Marcus took the time to properly onboard me onto the Jaguar codebase instead of just pointing me at the docs. First few weeks would've been a lot rockier without him.
Sara caught an inconsistency in our sustainability reporting figures before they went external — small thing, but would have been an awkward one to correct after the fact.
William automated a manual reconciliation step that used to eat a full afternoon every month end. Straightforward, high-impact, no fanfare about it.
Jacek stepped in on a Dept of Justice query out of hours and had the client back up and running before the next morning's stand-up.
Suraj proposed a cleaner approach to our SRG platform monitoring setup that cut our false-positive alerts right down. Team's a lot less twitchy at 2am now.
Ross made a point of pulling in the newer starters on the deal desk work rather than just doing it himself — noticeably better team morale since.
Hemanth's diligence on the service desk documentation meant our last audit had zero findings against us, first time in a while.

I would like to nominate Sara Wallace for the positive impact she has had on both the Sustainability Shadow Board and the people involved in it. Sara has a way of encouraging people to step outside their comfort zone while making them feel supported at the same time. She trusts people to take ownership, listens to different perspectives and gives credit where it is due. Her guidance and encouragement have helped me grow in confidence, take on new challenges and contribute more effectively. Sara consistently demonstrates Version 1's values through the time and energy she invests in helping others develop and succeed. Great Work Sara!

Grace got a 100% Compliance Score in her recent ISO audit for H&S Safety and Environmental documentation. Literally the prefect audit score. Without ISO accreditation we would not be able to deal with some of our clients , so its really important that we have documentation and policy in place.

Jitha is working on the Bank of England Project. She has been covering both technical support and data migration. Without her in both these areas we simply would have failed to deliver. She has worked long hours and alongside the customer she has turned around a delivery that was extremely challenging  The customer has reached out to me many times to pass their thanks for the work Jitha has carried out.

I would like to nominate Roopak for the positive and lasting impact he has had on our team. Since joining as Technical Team Lead, he has transformed the way we work by bringing structure, encouraging collaboration, and creating a supportive environment. His mentorship, guidance, and encouragement have helped me build confidence, improve my technical skills, and take on new challenges. He has fostered a culture of teamwork, learning, and growth, always making time to support and encourage the team. His leadership has had a lasting impact, and I am truly grateful for his guidance and support.

Hannah has provided nothing less than outstanding support to the Deal Governance programme over the last 12 months. She is always on the ball and an expert in navigating the intricacies of Version 1. In particular I have really valued how organised she has been with getting calls scheduled, minutes sent out promptly and decision makers chased down for their approvals. The significant exposure to the Deal Governance process as well as the qualification process sets Hannah up brilliantly as she moves into Bid Management. She knows the good, bad and the ugly and will be perfectly placed to steer bid teams through what good looks like.  Thank you for all your hard work!
Supported in the month end activities, exceptional performance while preparing GST and TDS reports on monthly basis.

Etienne stepped in to lead a complex EU project at a critical juncture during my annual leave, demonstrating exceptional ownership, Drive and Personal Commitment. He quickly assessed a challenging situation, understood the urgency of key deliverables, and took full accountability for leading the team through multiple daily engagements with internal stakeholders and the client. His determination and focus maintained momentum, managed risks, and kept objectives on track. Throughout, he demonstrated Honesty and Integrity through transparent communication, sound judgement, and trusted leadership. His contribution was recognised and praised by the client. Delivering value when it mattered most.

I have found William to be so helpful, knowledgeable and responsive to the many many queries I've had over my last two transitions. The role he played on, LDA was invaluable, he always provides clear and expert guidance. For my current transition, SAM practice are not even engaged, but with a customer first mindset and personal commitment William has supported me on contract novation, extension of supplier services and stepped in to help us get sort out an SSL quote, in short timescales to meet the customer need. Thank you William for all your support.

Sandeep resolved a long-standing user management issue on Coursera, our new learning platform. He identified the root cause of the broken automated provisioning and deprovisioning process, worked directly with the vendor to confirm a fix, and validated the solution end-to-end. This process underpins security, licence management, cost control, and timely onboarding, yet the work behind it is rarely visible. Sandeep's persistence and follow-through turned a broken process into a working, automated one. Excellent ownership and drive shown throughout.

I am nominating Shilpa for her exceptional leadership in driving our ESG and CSR initiatives. She successfully led the Environment Month activities, including the plant distribution initiative that encouraged sustainability across the organization. She also led the CSR initiative by bringing underprivileged children to our office, creating a meaningful and memorable experience for both the children and our employees. Her dedication, excellence, drive, and personal commitment have made a lasting positive impact on our people, community, and culture.

I want to recognize the excellent work you've done with the Playwright automation. Your implementation is well-structured, and has improved testing process by reducing manual effort. Thank you for your hard work and for setting a high standard with this automation.

Jacek has gone above and beyond in supporting and mentoring me throughout the quarter. He regularly makes time to help with technical challenges, explain complex concepts, and provide guidance on problem-solving and organisation. His support has had a significant impact on my confidence, development, and effectiveness in my role, and the benefit of that guidance will continue well beyond this quarter. He demonstrates No Ego through his willingness to share knowledge and Personal Commitment through the time and effort he invests in helping others grow

I would like to nominate Manish for a STAR Award for his exceptional support in resolving my Axis Bank login issue. He proactively coordinated with the banking team, followed up diligently, and ensured the issue was resolved in a timely manner. His ownership, responsiveness, and commitment to helping others significantly reduced delays and made the entire process smooth and hassle-free. I truly appreciate his dedication and customer-focused approach.

Suraj Singh consistently went above and beyond their responsibilities by taking ownership of critical tasks, collaborating effectively across teams, and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality results. Their proactive approach helped resolve issues quickly, minimized business impact, and improved the overall customer experience. Their support benefited both internal stakeholders and end users by reducing delays, improving operational efficiency, and maintaining service quality. The positive impact of their work is expected to be long-lasting, as the improvements they introduced continue to streamline processes and enhance team productivity.

Sachin took the initiative to create a comprehensive and structured PL/SQL Complexity Matrix assessment script to support the estimation estimation of Oracle PL/SQL components as part of application modernisation and migration initiatives. His work saves significant manual effort analysing a wide range of PL/SQL artefacts, identifying the characteristics that drive complexity, and establishing a clear, repeatable framework for categorising components based on their migration effort and technical risk.  Sachin demonstrated Excellence and Drive through his thorough analysis, attention to detail, and commitment to producing a high-quality deliverable.

Ross was assigned as bid manager to a Social Security Scotland opportunity. This was a new logo opportunity with the biggest Public Sector agency in Scotland, which we have just found out we have won. There was a very short timescale, with a reduced team, and Ross went above and beyond in getting the response together, editing, updating and reviewing - we scored 57.30% out of a possible 60% and this wouldn't have been possible without Ross.  His personal commitment, drive and excellence were vital to the Version 1 success.

Jocelyn has led the SCA programme as Delivery Manager and Programme Lead since February 2023 and continuing. She successfully coordinated around 90 team members during a highly complex Phase 2, maintained delivery momentum, supported on-time outcomes, and ensured business analysis deliverables were ready for technical teams. Her leadership has positively impacted the customer and the wider programme, with benefits continuing into future phases. She consistently demonstrates Excellence, Customer First, No Ego, and Honesty & Integrity. The customer Project Manager described her as “an amazing Project Manager who knows how to deal with customers through her consulting skills and capabilities.”

I am nominating Vinay for his exceptional contribution across ContentWatch EAR Server Replacement, Removal of Redundant Instances, and Sophos Server Migration Reach projects. Beyond delivery, he actively promotes knowledge sharing by encouraging colleagues to take ownership of production issues and mentoring team members through shadowing and guidance. He has been especially supportive of engineers new to the on-call rota, helping them diagnose issues, understand processes, and build confidence. His impact has strengthened team capability, improved service stability, and fostered a collaborative culture. Vinay truly embodies Excellence, No Ego, and Personal Commitment.
I want to call out Sean for passing the Az104 - its good to see him improving and up-skilling himself which is a benefit to self and the customer

Sijo has done a great job organizing our events, making them more structured, well-coordinated, and easier to execute.  Also they consistently demonstrate **Personal Commitment** by taking ownership of their work, going the extra mile when needed.

Since joining Version 1, my Team Lead has been a constant source of support, guidance, and leadership.   He shares his extensive process knowledge, mentors the team, and promotes collaboration, creating an organized and efficient work environment.   His coaching helped me improve my process knowledge, reduce errors, and handle cases faster, improving productivity and customer satisfaction.   He is always responsive and quick to act on approvals and team needs. He is Deserved for this Award.  He consistently demonstrates Excellence, No Ego, Personal Commitment, and Customer First, making a lasting positive impact on the team and our customers.

Sinead has almost singlehandedly transformed our Content Library from a fractured, inconsistent and very laborious to use tool, into a modern, AI-enabled repository. Previously content required hours of searching - now, through her careful cataloguing, storage, tagging and tireless search for content, it's literally taking me less than an hour to find large volumes of content needed for a bid.

Throughout the year, the nominee consistently demonstrated exceptional ownership, initiative, and commitment to delivering high-quality results. They proactively identified and resolved critical operational challenges, streamlined processes, and implemented improvements that enhanced system reliability, efficiency, and service quality. Their efforts helped minimize disruptions, improve response times, and ensure business continuity for both internal and external stakeholders.

I am nominating this colleague for their exceptional drive and commitment to resolving complex technical issues. They consistently go above and beyond when using Dynatrace to investigate incidents, identifying root causes rather than applying temporary fixes. Their expertise and willingness to help others have improved resolution times, reduced recurring issues, and enhanced the experience of both colleagues and customers. They demonstrate the Drive core value through their determination, proactive approach, and ownership of problems, while also showing Excellence by delivering thorough, high-quality investigations and sharing their knowledge to support team success.
Joshua recently showed Personal Commitment in taking on a P1 for LGMA. He also leads daily ticket calls, driving team open ticket numbers and resolution times down.

I am nominating Manoj for his exceptional contribution to software testing and the positive impact he has on the team. He consistently brings a sharp eye for detail, identifies critical issues early, and helps ensure we deliver high-quality products to our customers. Beyond his technical expertise, Manoj is always approachable, willing to share knowledge, and ready to support teammates whenever needed. His dedication, teamwork, and commitment to quality reflect our core values of Excellence, Customer First, and No Ego. His contributions have made a lasting difference to both the team and project success.

I am pleased to nominate Mohamed Irfan for his excellent contribution to the ARUP project. He is a dedicated and reliable tester who consistently ensures that every feature is thoroughly tested before release. His attention to detail has helped identify issues early, improve testing accuracy, and maintain high quality and compliance standards throughout the project. His work has contributed to smoother releases, reduced defects, and increased confidence in the overall product quality. The positive impact of his efforts has been felt across the team and will continue to benefit the project in the long run.
Fintan rebuilt our flaky integration test suite from the ground up — first time in months the pipeline has been green more often than red.
Fintan flagged a security misconfiguration in the Jaguar AWS setup before it went anywhere near production. Sharp eye, saved us a very bad week.
Marcus has been the steady hand keeping the Jaguar team's sprint planning honest all quarter — always realistic, never lets scope quietly creep.
Priya's the person everyone on the team goes to when something's genuinely stuck, and she never makes it feel like a silly question.
